decisions.reviewNotes: Two provider-owned fetches identify Heartwood as Dr Sarah Reed's practice in Whangārei and publish info@heartwoodpsychiatry.co.nz as the contact email. The current site does not publish the stored Gmail address or support telehealth, ADHD, or bipolar as advertised Heartwood specialties, so those ranking tags are removed. The stored mobile number is left unchanged because silence is not proof that it is invalid.
The provider-owned pages do not publish current availability or a psychiatry referral pathway. Neither is inferred from the contact form, and both remain not_published or unknown for later recheck.
